stories.title: Sinner n.1 sotto pressione: Zverev vince gli US Open e accorcia, ma il primato resiste

en.title: Sinner no. 1 under pressure: Zverev wins US Open and closes gap, but top ranking holds
en.summary: Zverev's US Open victory brings him closer to Sinner in the rankings, while Alcaraz falls out of contention for first place. For the first time since 2002, the top 10 contains no players from the Federer, Nadal, and Djokovic era.

stories.title: Castellammare di Stabia, sequestrata e violentata per ore ragazza conosciuta sui social

en.title: Castellammare di Stabia, young woman sequestered and assaulted for hours after meeting man on social media
en.summary: A barely-adult woman met a 26-year-old man through social media who lured her to his isolated basement and subjected her to hours of assault.

stories.title: Media Iran, Usa hanno escluso il capo agenzia nucleare di Teheran dal vertice Aiea

en.title: Iranian media: US excluded Tehran nuclear agency chief from IAEA summit
en.summary: According to Iranian media reports, the United States excluded Iran's nuclear agency head from an International Atomic Energy Agency meeting in Vienna.

stories.title: Castellammare, segregata e violentata per ore da un 26enne conosciuto sui social: arrestato

en.title: Castellammare, woman held captive and assaulted for hours by 26-year-old man met on social media: arrested
en.summary: A barely-adult woman was held hostage in a basement in early August by a man she met on social media. Carabinieri arrested the suspect.

stories.title: Omicidio via Poma, Paola Cesaroni: quando trovammo Simonetta, c'era qualcuno nascosto dentro

en.title: Via Poma murder, Paola Cesaroni: when we found Simonetta, there was someone hiding inside
en.summary: New questions have emerged regarding statements from the sister of a woman killed in 1990, with suggestions that someone may have cleaned up blood evidence at the scene.

stories.title: Sinner, cosa serve per restare numero 1. La classifica Atp dopo la vittoria di Zverev agli Us Open

en.title: Sinner, what it takes to stay number 1. ATP rankings after Zverev's US Open victory
en.summary: Zverev's victory at the US Open reduced the gap between him and the Italian player at the top of the ATP rankings to 1,810 points.

stories.title: Sequestra e violenta per ore una ragazza conosciuta sui social. Arrestato 26enne nel Napoletano

en.title: Man arrests after kidnapping and assaulting girl met on social media. 26-year-old detained in Naples area
en.summary: A 26-year-old was arrested for kidnapping and beating a young woman he had met online, holding her captive for several hours.

stories.title: Meghan e Harry, la nuova vita in Uk: il video con Archie e Lilibet tra boschi, bici e caminetto

en.title: Meghan and Harry, their new life in UK: video with Archie and Lilibet among woods, bikes and fireplace
en.summary: The Duke and Duchess of Sussex shared Instagram footage showing their family enjoying outdoor activities in the UK following their return from California after six years.

stories.title: Meghan e Harry, le immagini della vita in famiglia dopo il ritorno in Gran Bretagna

en.title: Meghan and Harry, images of family life after return to Britain
en.summary: The couple relocated to the United States after stepping down from senior roles in the royal family in 2020.

stories.title: Attacchi Houthi sull'oleodotto saudita, vola il prezzo del petrolio

en.title: Houthi attacks on Saudi oil pipeline drive up oil prices
en.summary: Houthi attacks on a Saudi pipeline have increased oil prices. Talks between Iran and Gulf countries have been postponed amid regional tensions.

stories.title: Raid russo vicino alla Polonia, paura per diplomatici europei: "nel mirino un treno per Varsavia"

en.title: Russian raid near Poland, concern for European diplomats: a train to Warsaw in the target
en.summary: A Russian attack near Poland raised alarm among European and NATO officials, with Ukraine's Foreign Minister warning of Russian threats and Trump calling for a halt to Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries.

stories.title: La sorella di Simonetta Cesaroni: “La trovai morta e nella casa di via Poma c’era qualcuno nascosto”

en.title: Sister of Simonetta Cesaroni: "I found her dead and there was someone hiding in the via Poma house"
en.summary: The sister of Simonetta Cesaroni provides testimony in a new book about discovering the body and evidence suggesting either the killer or someone else was present in the house.

stories.title: Crescono i consumi del gelato italiano e il Sigep di Rimini raddoppia i buyer

en.title: Italian ice cream consumption grows and Sigep in Rimini doubles buyers
en.summary: Italian food products, including ice cream, bread, pizza and coffee, are gaining increased foreign attention. Sigep in Rimini will double its number of international buyers this year.

stories.title: Ex Ilva, sciopero di 24 ore e blocco delle strade

en.title: Ex Ilva, 24-hour strike and road blockade
en.summary: Workers at the Taranto facility are protesting over potential layoffs affecting 2,500 employees, with a meeting scheduled at the Prime Minister's office.

stories.title: Progetti speciali e nuove giostre, Zamperla punta ai 130 milioni di fatturato

en.title: Special projects and new rides, Zamperla targets 130 million revenue
en.summary: The multinational company celebrates 60 years and introduced a new attraction called Hypnosiz, with ongoing work for Disney and Universal as well as multi-year contracts.
